excerpts.excerpt: an open architectural framework and capability registry that formally separates what an agent wants to do from how that task is executed.
Skillware equips them with modular, versioned software capability bundles.
each bundle combines a typed JSON input contract, deterministic Python code, task directives, bundled datasets, and automated unit tests.
an executable predicate guaranteeing that the Effect satisfies the Contract independently of external model APIs
Every skill must ship with comprehensive offline tests ensuring that the Effect honors the Contract.
and in continuous integration before any skill is admitted into the registry.
In classical computing, operating systems do not generate utility binaries at runtime; they package pre-compiled, verifiable, and isolated software libraries behind typed system calls.
